channel.title: Objects on ZooBerry
channel.description: Recent content in Objects on ZooBerry

item.title: Foliage
item.description: Make your animals feel more at home with new living flora.

item.title: JPOG Items
item.description: A collection of items in JPOG style.

item.title: Objects
item.description: Any inanimate objects including buildings, fences, paths, animal enrichment items, etc.

item.title: Pampas Grass
item.description: The Pampas Grass ztd is a south america plant that can be used in the Rhea’s exhibit, but it is not obligatory. I’ve created it from the z2f file made by Aurora Designs.

item.title: Theme Packs
item.description: Bundles of objects all curated or designed after a specific theme.

item.title: Portable Restrooms
item.description: A mundane, plastic portable restroom for lower-budget zoos and parks. Functional restroom for guests, with a capacity of 2 (same as ingame Small Restrooms).

item.title: Scenery
item.description: Objects that are designed to just sit there and look pretty!

item.title: Muted Iron Bars
item.description: A small mod that edits the palette for both large and small iron bar fences to remove the blue hue, as well as updating the icons to match.

item.title: Fences
item.description: Fence in your animals with these decorative and functional fences!

item.title: Modern Wooden Fences
item.description: Adds a set of modern wooden fences to your zoo created by Vondell.

item.title: Bowl Fountain
item.description: A beautifully designed fountain created using Wings3D, with rotation fixes by Yellowrose.

item.title: Desert Pack
item.description: A collection of original desert-themed objects by Quivaz, with technical support from Casey.

item.title: Dodo Statue
item.description: A Dodo Bird statue your guests will love, adding a unique touch to your zoo.

item.title: Flower Fountain
item.description: A fountain with a continuous stream of water and surrounded by flower beds, perfect for boosting guest happiness.

item.title: Fossil House and Deepsea Aquarium
item.description: The Fossil House and Deepsea Aquarium are researchable rides found in Dino Digs and Marine Mania filters.

item.title: Primeval Abyssal Pack
item.description: The Primeval Abyssal Pack includes prehistoric animals, statues, and the Primeval Abyssal Aquarium.

item.title: Star Wars Expansion Pack (SWEP)
item.description: The Star Wars Expansion Pack includes a Jawa, Ewok, Wookie, Wampa Ice Creature, and a new observation area object.

item.title: SWEP2
item.description: SWEP2 adds new Star Wars-themed content, including an updated Jawa, R2D2, Sandcrawler, and various statues and buildings.

item.title: ZTU Black Tiger Showcase
item.description: Part of the ZTU Collection, the Black Tiger Showcase highlights your Black Tiger exhibits.

item.title: ZTU Panda Bear Showcase
item.description: Part of the ZTU Collection, the Panda Bear Showcase enhances your panda exhibits with a realistic touch.

item.title: Seekings of Depth
item.description: SeeKings of Depth is a mod pack that adds a variety of prehistoric sea creatures to Zoo Tycoon 1.

item.title: Dinosaur Digs Marketing Beta Pack
item.description: A pack that converts content from the Dinosaur Digs marketing beta to the retail version of the game.

item.title: Mexico Natural Icons Pack
item.description: A pack containing five new animals, five new foliage items, and five new animated scenery items.

item.title: Toadally Batrocious Land Invaders
item.description: A pack full of ancient amphibians for your zoos! This pack is a Halloween gift for all of you! Toadally Batrocious (TB) is the third of the “Works on Lacking Stuff” projects.

item.title: Mischievous Erradicators of Outside Wildlife (M.E.O.W.)
item.description: Dedicated to my two cat sisters, Vega & Rigel, whose birthday is on September 7th. Also dedicated to all cat lovers!

item.title: Bug Mayhem
item.description: A little expansion pack containing items for a full terrarium of arthropods!

item.title: Buildings
item.description: Functional buildings such as food stands, carts, restaurants, etc.

item.title: UFO Ride
item.description: A gravitron for ZT1!

item.title: Balloon Animal Stand

item.title: Atlantean Fountain
item.description: This Atlantean Fountain will fit in seamlessly with Zoo Tycoon’s other Atlantean scenery items!

item.title: Hotdog Stand
